info.title: sayIt local service
info.description: Version 1 of the private localhost speech API. Health is public; every other operation requires a per-user bearer token.

ModelVoiceCapabilities.description: Additive fields on each /models entry. Voice cloning can be optional when a model also supplies a default preset.

language_selection.description: This model accepts a separately selected speech language.

voice_discovery.description: The installed native Qwen Base backend can generate unconditioned voice candidates.

random_voice_sampling.description: Native Qwen Base supports automatic stable and per-paragraph random reading without a saved voice profile.

voice_generation_tuning.description: Saved profiles for this model accept Qwen generation controls.

selected_language.description: Saved per-model language code, including auto for automatic detection. Null when the model has no separate language selection.

requires_voice_profile.description: The current installed configuration requires a saved voice profile before speech can be queued. Older Pocket installations need a preset-pack update to make profiles optional.

language.description: Qwen language code. Stored per model and retained across updates and backend changes.

VoiceSynthesisMode.description: Standard uses the selected profile or preset. Native Qwen automatic_stable prepares one temporary synthetic reference per reading; random_per_paragraph prepares one per newline-delimited paragraph and reuses it across bounded blocks. Preparation audio is neither played nor archived. Random modes add preparation latency and do not create saved profiles.

SpeechJobVoiceFields.description: Additive fields on queued jobs and history jobs. Regeneration preserves the captured mode. Legacy jobs without voice_mode default to standard.

VoiceModeSettings.description: Additive response fields on GET /settings. Update through the model voice-mode endpoint or saved-profile selection, rather than POST /settings.

voice_mode_by_model.description: Saved random mode per model. Native Qwen without a profile defaults to automatic_stable. Selecting a saved profile clears this model's random-mode preference.

model_id.description: Optional installed model ID. Defaults to the active model and is captured on the queued job/history. An override uses that model's saved profile and language without changing the global selection. Older history without model_id keeps its legacy active-model behavior.

language.description: Optional per-request language code for models with language selection. The effective language is captured when queued and returned on the job and its history entry; changing the saved default does not change queued jobs.

voice_mode.description: Optional captured override. Defaults to standard with a profile or unsupported backend, otherwise the model's saved random mode or automatic_stable. Random overrides ignore the global profile selection; explicitly supplying a profile together with a random mode is rejected. Standard native Qwen still requires a profile.

speaking_pace.description: Optional native generation pace for supported models.

PlaybackProgress.description: Additive fields on /state.playback. duration_seconds is generated source audio, independent of listening speed. Seeking is limited to generated audio. PCM can play before generation_complete becomes true; buffering does not mean the job finished.

buffering.description: Waiting for more playable audio. Position does not advance while buffering.

generation_complete.description: All synthesis has completed; remaining buffered audio can still be playing or paused.

amplitudes.description: Source-audio RMS waveform bins in chronological order, downsampled for long documents.

precision.description: Native weight precision; defaults to int4.

path.description: Local exported Phonon .safetensors file, up to 8 MB.

reference_audio_path.description: Local 16-bit PCM WAV containing 3–45 seconds of speech for Qwen, or 3–15 seconds for PocketTTS, after silence trimming.

reference_text.description: Exact words spoken in the reference audio, in its original language. Required and nonblank for new Qwen profiles; optional for PocketTTS. Stored locally with the profile and supplied to Qwen for full audio-and-text conditioning.

Exact transcript of this profile's original recording. Must be nonblank; surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Applies to future generations. Older profiles without this field continue to use embedding-only Qwen cloning until a transcript is added.

sample_text.description: Length bounds apply after configured text cleaning.

language.description: Optional Qwen language code. Defaults to the selected model's saved language.

seed.description: First candidate's seed; subsequent candidates increment it with 32-bit wrapping. Null chooses a random seed.

randomize_tuning.description: Choose a separate bounded tuning recipe for each candidate. Recipes are repeatable for the same seed with the pinned runtime; each candidate returns its actual tuning, which is retained when saved.

save_error.description: Audio quality or duration prevents reuse as a reference. Preview remains available.

VoiceDiscoverySnapshot.description: One ephemeral collection per service, at most 32 candidates. New batches append for the same model. Restarting discards unsaved candidates. Preview creates no speech history.

completed.description: Completed candidates in the current batch.

total.description: Requested candidates in the current batch.

GeneratedVoiceProfileFields.description: Additive saved-profile fields. Legacy profiles default to false/null/null, preserving their generation behavior.

language.description: Preferred language restored on explicit profile selection.

generation_tuning.description: Controls applied to new readings with this profile. Null retains the backend's legacy defaults.

compute_device.description: Automatic prefers a compatible GPU for every inference path, including previews and benchmarks. CPU forces CPU execution. Pinned GPU runtimes are prepared on first use. The last selected backend and CPU fallback reason appear in /state.inference_device; loaded models expose inference_device in /models.

speaking_pace.description: Native pace for models supporting it. Pocket, Phonon, and Qwen use natural pace (1.0) regardless of this saved preference; non-1.0 per-job requests are rejected. playback_rate remains independent.

history_retention_days.description: Maximum age of unpinned history. Zero retains it indefinitely.
